race.title: Doncaster 2027 Annual Membership Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: COPSHILL LAD underperformed at Ffos Las when last seen in May but he has a notably good record fresh, which makes him an appealing proposition. Camarrate has run well on all 3 of his chase starts and seems likely to give another good account, while Mumford's Magic is also respected back down in grade. COPSHILL LAD (IRE) CAMARRATE (IRE) MUMFORD'S MAGIC (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Mumford's Magic (11/8), Camarrate (2/1), Copshill Lad (4/1), Getaway Vic (8/1), Breezethroughlife (33/1), I Am The Moon (33/1)
